basis: Defining cleft palate, retinopathy and developmental delay; chronic dermatitis 2/2. Hearing impairment 2/3 omitted by the four-axis cap.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: chronic atopic dermatitis in 2/2 assessed patients supports direct skin inflammation; retained under the cap.
decisions.otologic: none: hearing impairment in 2/3 qualifies by frequency but is omitted under the cap, favoring the more frequent chronic skin disease.

basis: Cholestasis and severe chronic subcutaneous lymphedema define the syndrome; frequent lipomas further support skin/subcutis involvement. Nutritional sequelae do not establish other direct organ injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: lymphatic dysfunction does not establish disease of the heart or blood vessels covered by this axis.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: defining chronic lymphedema affects skin/subcutis; pigmentation changes and subcutaneous lipomas are also frequent (30-79%).

basis: The supplied definition and parent identify a pineal-body neoplasm: a brain tumor involving an endocrine gland.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the definition explicitly identifies a pineal-body neoplasm; the pineal gland is an endocrine gland, irrespective of hormonal secretion by the tumor.

basis: Mitochondrial metabolic defect; cardiomyopathy 80-99%, developmental delay 4/12; hypotonia 4/12 with COX-negative muscle fibers 4/4 supports direct muscle dysfunction.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: COX-negative muscle fibers in 4/4 tested plus hypotonia in 4/12 support direct mitochondrial muscle dysfunction at approximately the 30% threshold.

basis: Inherited iron overload; liver injury commonly affects >50% of clinical cases and characteristic arthropathy ~30-50%. Cardiac injury is a minority complication; deposition alone is insufficient.

decisions.hepatic: involved: iron-related liver injury is common (>50% in clinical disease); the defining disorder is systemic iron metabolism, rather than an obligatory liver disease.

basis: Intellectual disability, spastic paraplegia, palmoplantar keratoderma and pes cavus are defining features; cone-shaped epiphyses occur in 80-99%. Ocular findings are occasional.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: bilateral pes cavus is explicitly part of the defining syndrome; cone-shaped epiphyses (80-99%) and frequent digital/joint abnormalities reinforce skeletal disease.

basis: Defining neuropathic bladder dysfunction and abnormal facial motor control support urinary and neural disease. Recurrent UTIs are separate infections; constipation alone does not establish gut damage.

decisions.neurologic: primary: the defining neurogenic bladder and characteristic facial motor dysfunction reflect intrinsic urofacial neuropathy, rather than merely secondary urinary injury.

basis: Most major DSD groups involve gonadal dysgenesis or abnormal sex-hormone production/action; gonads as hormone organs belong to the endocrine axis.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: gonadal dysgenesis and disorders of sex-hormone synthesis/action characterize most major DSD groups; the umbrella rule does not require endocrine dysfunction in every subtype.

basis: Thymic gland pathology has endocrine ancestry. Immune-organ location alone does not establish immunodeficiency, autoimmunity or lymphoma; blood-cell disease is not inherent across this umbrella.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the thymus has endocrine activity and an explicit endocrine-system parent; endocrine-gland pathology does not require hormonal hypersecretion.
decisions.infectious_immune: none: an immune organ's location alone does not meet this mechanism axis; infection, immunodeficiency, autoimmunity and lymphoma are not intrinsic across this umbrella.

basis: PGM3 glycosylation immunodeficiency; CNS damage ~60-88%, eczema 80-99%. Bronchiectasis 11/17 follows separate infections; hearing loss 4/8 and cutaneous vasculitis 30-79% omitted by cap.

decisions.pulmonary: none: bronchiectasis (11/17) follows recurrent respiratory infections, separately diagnosed complications; direct glycosylation-related lung injury is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent eczematoid dermatitis in 80-99% reflects intrinsic cutaneous immune inflammation, beyond separately diagnosed skin infections.
